summary: Kerb on a multi-lane arterial at a junction; no stopping, no room.

drivers.seclusion: Trees and bush on the west side, but the kerb is in the middle of a busy junction.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb runs on live lanes and turning arrows; no bay or shoulder.
drivers.traffic: Multi-lane arterial with buses and heavy traffic.
drivers.convention: No Stopping Any Time; no cars parked along this kerb.

flags: Low-lying: about 10 m elevation, Witton Creek 53 m away
sun_shade: Trees shade the west side; road open to sun.
